name: South Carolina
agency: South Carolina Department of Motor Vehicles (SCDMV)
permitAge: 15 (beginner's permit), after passing the vision and knowledge tests (manual p. 1-4; SC Code 56-1-50). No driver education needed for the permit itself.

teen.supervisedHours: 40 hours, including 10 at night, with a parent, guardian or other person listed in SC Code 56-1-100(A)(1-7), for ages 15 and 16 (manual p. 1-5, 1-6); plus driver education, 8 hours classroom and 6 hours driving (p. 1-6)
teen.holdPermit: 180 days if 17 or younger; 30 days if 18 or older (manual p. 1-4, 1-5; revision 11/13/24)
teen.nightLimit: Permit: 6 a.m. to midnight with a licensed driver 21+ with 1 year of experience in the front seat; midnight to 6 a.m. only with a licensed parent/guardian or other person in SC Code 56-1-100(A)(1-7) (p. 1-4). Conditional (15½ to 16) and special restricted (16 to 17) licenses: alone 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. (8 p.m. in daylight saving time); until midnight with a licensed driver 21+; midnight to 6 a.m. only with a licensed person from 56-1-100(A)(1-7) (p. 1-7, 1-8). A waiver allows driving alone until midnight for work or activities (p. 1-9).
teen.passengerLimit: No more than 2 passengers under 21 unless a licensed adult 21+ is in the car; family members and students to and from school are exempt (manual p. 1-7, 1-8)
teen.phone: All drivers: Hands-Free and Distracted Driving Act: no holding or supporting a phone, no texting, no video; earpiece or wrist device for voice calls allowed; $100 first offense, $200 and 2 points after (manual p. 3-4, 3-5). Primary offense: an officer may stop a driver on a clear view of a violation (SC Code 56-5-3890, 2025 Act 40, effective Sept. 1, 2025, warnings only for the first 180 days).

bac.adult: 0.08 (SC Code 56-5-2933; not stated in the manual)
bac.under21: 0.02: driving privilege suspended immediately for at least 3 months; refusing the test: at least 6 months (manual p. 3-7)

notes: Handbook: SCDMV Driver's License Manual, PDF created 2026-03-30 (posted under files/2026-04), pages numbered by section (e.g. 1-4). Its revision history page lists changes through 11/13/24 (30-day permit hold for 18+). Checked 2026-10-09.

Knowledge test size (30 questions, 24 correct, 80 percent) is NOT in the manual or on dmv.sc.gov; only third-party sites give it. Test languages are not stated officially; no Spanish manual on dmv.sc.gov/forms-and-manuals.
SCDMV: $2.00 knowledge test fee, $2.50 permit fee (dmv.sc.gov beginner-permits page).

Conditional license: 15½ to 16; special restricted license: 16 to 17; full privileges at 17 or after 1 year with no offenses or at-fault collisions (manual p. 1-7 to 1-9). Under 17 with 6+ points in the first year: 6-month suspension (p. 1-8).
Move over (manual p. 10-15): slow down and change to a lane away from a stopped emergency vehicle if safe; otherwise slow down and keep a safe speed.
School bus (manual p. 7-9, 7-10; SC Code 56-5-2760): always stop when behind; opposite direction need not stop on a highway with at least two lanes each way (median not mentioned).
Speed limits (SC Code 56-5-1520): 70 mph on interstates where posted, 60 on multilane divided primary highways, 55 elsewhere, 30 in urban districts. Not in the manual.
